name: Quality Wood & Metal Designs
old_description: Quality Wood Designs specializes in solving problems. With a clear focus on retail security and merchandising solutions, we have a deep catalog of products tailored to meet your specific needs.
about:
Quality Wood & Metal Designs operates from Mitchell, South Dakota, where it was founded in 1961 by Vic Honermann. The business remains family-owned; Vic’s son Mike took over in the 1980s and now runs the company with his wife, Jo Ann.

The shop provides full-service custom fabrication in wood and metal, housing a woodshop, laser cutting, brake press forming, powder coating, and finishing under one roof. In-house drafting and design, store layout planning, warehousing, and custom fixturing allow the team to take projects from concept to finished product without outsourcing.

The company serves retail, residential, equipment, and safety‑and‑security markets, with a noted focus on firearms merchandising. Customers range from independent gun shops such as BattleHawk Armory to multinational corporations, and the product line includes gondola systems, secure display cases, and the Gun Warden home firearm storage unit.

Quality Wood & Metal Designs emphasizes a problem‑solving approach rooted in Midwestern ethics — service, hard work, good value, and dependability. It promotes its Made‑in‑the‑USA manufacturing and on‑site capabilities as a way to meet tight timelines and budgets consistently.
